d: On 26 October, Saudi Arabia’s Defence Minister, Prince Khalid bin Salman, the Crown Prince’s own brother, flew to Tehran: the capital of the country Riyadh accuses of arming the Houthis. The same day, the Israeli newspaper Israel Hayom reported that Saudi Arabia had offered the Houthis a $1 billion package to stop their attacks, routed through Iran. Saudi Arabia has not confirmed any payment.
